senses.gloss: भट् BHAṬ, cs. P. [Pr. den. fr. bhaṭa] 🞄bhāṭaya, hire.

भट bhaṭa, m. [Pr. for bhṛta, hired], mercenary, 🞄soldier, warrior;
 hireling, servant.

भट्ट bhaṭṭa, m. [Pr. for bhartṛ], doctor 🞄(designation of great scholars: the real name 🞄often being omitted, = e. g. Kumārila);
 ā, f. 🞄N. of a sorceress.

भाट bhāṭa: ˚क -ka, n. hire, wages;
 rent.
भाट्ट bhāṭṭa, m. follower of Kumārila-bhaṭṭa: 🞄pl. N. of a people.
भटीय bhaṭ-īya, a. relating to Āryabhaṭa.

भट्टवार्त्तिक bhaṭṭa-vārttika, n. T. of a work;
 🞄-ācārya, m. famous teacher (gnly. designation 🞄of Kumārila-bhaṭṭa).

भट्टि bhaṭṭi, m. N. of the author of the Bhaṭṭikāvya 🞄(by various commentators identified 🞄with Bhartṛhari): -kāvya, n. the poem of 🞄Bhaṭṭi (sixth or seventh century A. D.), the 🞄main object of which, while describing the 🞄deeds of Rāma, is to illustrate the forms of 🞄Sanskrit grammar.

भाटि bhāṭi, f. wages;
 earning of prostitution.
भट्टोजि bhaṭṭo-ji, m. N. of a grammarian, 🞄author of the Siddhānta-kaumudī: -dīkṣita, -bhaṭṭa, m. id..
भट्टोत्पल bhaṭṭa‿utpala, m. N. of a commentator 🞄of Varāhamihiraʼs works, who lived in 🞄the tenth century.
